description: Launch the installed Unreal editor to materialize a prepared job as a separate native work level. Writes generated assets and that level only; original native meshes/materials remain shared. Continues after the MCP call ends. Closing and relaunching the same job resumes saved checkpoints without duplicate actors. Returns status location, never claims visual acceptance.

job_directory.description: Persistent local directory returned by prepare_local.

name: gripforge_map_unreal_import_local
title: Import/resume a map in Unreal
